name: Coucou
description: Monitors Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and other coding-agent sessions from a desktop notch or phone, so developers can approve permissions and answer questions.

skills.name: Session Monitoring
skills.description: Shows each coding-agent session live, including the files it reads and edits, the commands it runs, and per-file diffs.

skills.name: Permission Approvals
skills.description: Surfaces Claude Code permission requests with Allow, Deny or Always on the desktop island, the iPhone Lock Screen, or Android.

skills.name: Question Answering
skills.description: Displays Claude Code AskUserQuestion prompts with their choices so you can answer from the island instead of the terminal.

skills.name: Custom Agent Hooks
skills.description: Accepts hook events from any agent through the coucou-hook relay with an --agent flag, giving that agent its own pill.
